answer.reason: The same coverage obligation is unsatisfied before and after: Minify can reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string, but the old harness returns on parse failure before calling it. The blocker is preexisting.

scope_contract.reason: Minify is a primary operation of this entry. In both source versions, its implementation accepts a NUL-terminated string and removes single-line comments.

feasible_trigger.reason: The witness passes the entry's flag and terminal-NUL checks. Minify would skip its entire comment and newline, then write a NUL at the start of the copied body.

observable_consequence.reason: In both versions, parsing the body's initial slash fails and returns NULL. The harness then returns before Minify, making the supported empty whole-input result unreachable.

evidence.quote:
json = cJSON_ParseWithOpts((const char*)data + offset, NULL, require_termination);

    if(json == NULL) return 0;

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: A parse-successful body must begin with a JSON value after parser whitespace handling. Minify retains that value, so a JSON value followed by a comment may exercise comment skipping but cannot yield the same empty whole-input result. The complete entry has no other Minify call.

identity_preserved.reason: Both assessments concern the same tuple: Minify, a whole-input single-line comment, an empty output, and the parse gate blocking the call. The Minify implementation and old harness gate are the same on both sides.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: cJSON_Minify reduces a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Call Minify on a writable NUL-terminated body containing "//\n".
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry parses the body first and returns if parsing yields NULL.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The comment-only body cannot reach Minify, so the empty whole-input result is unreachable.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: A parsed JSON value followed by a comment can reach Minify, but Minify retains the JSON value and therefore cannot produce the empty whole-input result.
